correctness.rationale: The target is explicitly a regular ordered-word Boolean cell complex of ten facets. Exhaustive generation yields dimension-face counts 5,20,48,41,10. The packaged standard-library checker constructs all 124 cells, every signed incidence and 60 selected free-face pairs. It verifies the complete matched/unmatched Hasse orientation is acyclic, all 60 unit integral cancellation pivots, and zero differential on critical words (1), (4,1,5), (5,2,3), (2,1,4,5). A separate exact rational boundary-rank computation gives ranks 4,16,30,10 for dimensions 1-4, corroborating Betti ranks 2 in degree 2 and 1 in degree 3, but the actual integral homotopy claim relies on the matching and Hurewicz/attaching-map proof, not merely rational ranks. Small parameters 2-4 are exhaustively matched, proving minimality. No infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Targeted published-finding corpus searches and accessible primary full texts compare generator sets, exact objects, face vectors and implication, not title matches alone. The nearest five-letter affine-group result has twenty different generator words and 5,20,60,80,20 cells, whereas the ten transpositions give 5,20,48,41,10; no reduction or implication from its homotopy S^2 wedge 17 S^3 determines the new two-plus-one sphere wedge. A nearby cyclic/dihedral-word theorem selects all rotations and reversals and has an entirely different degree-two-only homotopy calculation. The 2026 pattern-avoiding shellability theorem does not select a transposition conjugacy class; the 2019 theorem explicitly classifies two-permutation generators, not the set of ten. No indexed covering result was located after alias and exact-parameter searches, with residual unindexed-source risk. A verified 2023 theorem makes the superseding nonderangement-complement complex contractible; a proper subcomplex has no forced homotopy type from that theorem.
residual_risks: No index search can establish absolute worldwide priority; unindexed, inaccessible or differently titled exact transposition calculations may exist.
An all-parameter transposition-family formula may exist but was not found in the accessible compared primary sources.

value.rationale: All transpositions are a canonical, conjugation-invariant and exceptionally sparse family of generators in the symmetric group; deciding how sparse natural generating classes alter full injective-word topology is motivated by 2026 work on selected-word subcomplexes. The first mixed-positive-degree case at the smallest possible alphabet size is structurally informative: despite being pure four-dimensional with ten maximal facets, the complex is nonshellable and has two distinct positive homotopy dimensions, in contrast with the full complex and shellable pattern-avoidance families. The exact homotopy type and minimality are not routine Euler-characteristic deductions, because the lone three-cell could attach nontrivially to two two-spheres without integral attaching verification. The precise finite threshold is valuable even without an all-parameter theorem.
